title: 阿亚拉CEO：7亿美元大单，三菱为何押注菲律宾？
speaker: Cezar Consing

segments.en: They will send people our way, we're talking about maybe a dozen people, will place them in some of our key operating companies.
segments.zh: 他们会派人过来，大概十几个人，安排到我们一些关键运营公司。

segments.en: We'll place some at the center at Ayala Corp. They'll help us out, help us think through the kind of focus and discipline that is needed to really create the kind of values we're all looking for here.
segments.zh: 我们也会在阿亚拉集团总部安排一些人。他们会帮我们梳理所需的专注与纪律，以真正创造我们都在寻找的价值。

segments.en: And at the same time on a regular basis, probably before the board meetings, we intend to sit down with them, discuss key important points of focus and really figure out how we're going to drive value.
segments.zh: 同时我们会定期，大概在董事会前，与他们坐下来讨论关键重点，真正想清楚如何推动价值。

segments.en: Seven hundred million dollars, it's a lot of money. It is a big bet on our company and our country and we want to make sure that it pays off for them.
segments.zh: 七亿美元，这是很大一笔钱。这是对我们公司和国家的重大押注，我们要确保对他们有回报。

segments.en: Right, and Mr. Consing, if you could elaborate more on what you actually plan to do then with the seven hundred million, how do you plan to let's call it disperse that?
segments.zh: 康辛先生，能否进一步说明这七亿美元具体打算怎么用，怎么分配？

segments.en: All right, the seven hundred million, of the seven hundred million dollars, that's about forty five billion pesos more or less.
segments.zh: 好的，这七亿美元，大约相当于四百五十亿比索左右。

segments.en: We'll take twenty billion pesos into Ayala Corp right, we'll issue shares for that. So that twenty billion pesos we'll use: number one, reduce debt.
segments.zh: 我们会把两百亿比索投入阿亚拉集团，为此发行股份。这两百亿比索用途：第一，降低债务。

segments.en: Number two, acquire shares in some of our listed companies that we feel are grossly undervalued. And number three, grow some of our businesses.
segments.zh: 第二，配置一些我们认为严重低估的上市公司的权益。第三，发展部分业务。

segments.en: So that's twenty billion of the forty five billion pesos. The twenty billion of that forty five billion pesos will also be used in a tender offer.
segments.zh: 这是四百五十亿比索中的两百亿。另外两百亿将用于要约收购。

segments.en: We will conduct, on behalf of Mitsubishi, a tender offer for up to twenty billion shares in the market, and at the same price.
segments.zh: 我们将代表三菱，在市场上进行最多两百亿股的要约收购，价格相同。

segments.en: So we're talking about six hundred fifty pesos a share, both for our primary and for the tender offer.
segments.zh: 所以是每股六百五十比索，无论是增发还是要约收购。

segments.en: And are there going to be more joint projects between Ayala and Mitsubishi here?
segments.zh: 阿亚拉和三菱之间还会有更多联合项目吗？
